accounting_rules: Reserve a slot and its full bound before transmission.
A transmitted or possibly transmitted request remains consumed.
Missing provider usage is UNKNOWN, never zero.
UTC rollover never resets cumulative experiment counters.
Each UTC day must independently fit available free allowance after all other account usage.
The larger checker output allowance includes all answer and reasoning output and is required for claim identification plus assessment fields.

The three-day route is only arithmetically feasible under the saved 10000-neuron daily Free allocation; each day still requires fresh eligibility and available-allowance evidence after other account use.
